response.justification: The candidate demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals, experience with distributed systems, and emerging leadership capabilities, but falls critically short on a core minimum requirement: 8 years of C++ programming (has approximately 1 year). Their expertise is primarily in full-stack and web development rather than cloud compute platform specialization, making them misaligned with this role's technical requirements.
strengths: Deep expertise in testing, TDD, and software craftsmanship across multiple senior roles and educational initiatives
Proven experience building large-scale distributed systems handling millions of requests per second with microservices architecture
Demonstrated technical leadership through multiple senior positions, technical workshops, and mentoring activities
concerns: Critical shortage of C++ experience (approximately 1 year vs. 8 years minimum requirement)
Career focus primarily on full-stack and web development rather than cloud compute or systems programming specialization
Limited formal technical leadership experience in cloud or compute-focused engineering teams
